When mentioned, contextual information from the task will be shown in your Google document. Jira Cloud comment syncing also enhances integration with Jira. [...] Overall, Asana does a fine job providing support. We found it easy to access the guides, the forums and the Asana Academy, and even though it took a little while, we also got decent support from a live agent. So we feel confident saying that you’ll end up with good customer service and support from Asana overall. ## The Verdict Asana has proven itself to be a capable project management tool. The user interface is slick and easy to use, and the views and automations will help you manage projects efficiently. The free version of Asana — with its kanban boards, lists and calendars, integrations, and more — is one of the best free tiers we have used.

supported_claims.text: Asana offers a free Personal plan for individuals and small teams, with paid plans starting at $10.99 per user per month when billed annually.
Asana's Advanced plan costs $24.99 per user per month under annual billing.
Asana paid plans can reach $30.49 per user per month when billed monthly.
Asana provides custom pricing for its Enterprise and Enterprise+ tiers and does not publicly list those rates.
Competitor Trello offers paid plans ranging from $5 to $17.50 per user per month depending on the tier.
Competitor monday.com's paid work management plans range from roughly $9 to $19 per seat per month billed annually before custom Enterprise pricing.
Competitor ClickUp's paid plans range from $7 to $19 per user per month depending on tier and billing frequency.
Asana's pricing is generally viewed as average compared to other project management platforms.
Asana competes with project management platforms including Trello, monday.com, ClickUp, Wrike, and Jira.
Trello manages work on boards with cards representing tasks, while Asana organizes work into projects containing subtasks, custom fields, and status tracking.
Trello is frequently positioned as best for simple projects and small teams, whereas Asana is frequently positioned as best for enterprise teams with complex needs.
Asana and monday.com both have a strong presence in the marketing and advertising, IT services, computer software, and non-profit organization management sectors.
monday.com offers native document collaboration and digital whiteboards, while Asana provides document collaboration and whiteboarding through integrations.
Asana introduced a 2026 redesign focused on AI-first navigation with embedded AI Teammates, following monday.com's 2025 interface update that included claims of faster load times.
ClickUp offers more than 1,000 native integrations, compared with over 200 native integrations each for Asana and monday.com.
Asana focuses on internal task management and team collaboration, while some competitors specialize in client work with built-in time tracking and budgeting.
Asana's dollar-based net retention rate was 97% in the second quarter of fiscal 2027.
